WHY_IT_FAILED_AND_IT_IS_NOT_THAT_THE_BUI.which_makes_the_next_move_a_SHAPE_change: The bundle population currently rides the diffuse term, so its contribution scales with N.L and is worth ~2x more at 0.93 than at 0.49. plate-01's top quartile is a dense-scattering fibre bundle; dense scattering is substantially view-and-not-key dependent. Put the bundle's lift on the transmission floor (`sssMask`, which section 3d already multiplies by (0.90 + 0.42*bun) at area mean 1.00) rather than on the diffuse, and re-solve `capBudget` at N.L = 0.5 instead of 1.0, and the top quartile appears where the frame actually lives.

fix: One change, in src/fruit/species.js, and do NOT touch the collar shading, the roughness, or capShade/capKey — the collar is the one thing on this axis that is now behaving. The bundle population added this round is gated behind the diffuse term, so it is worth roughly twice as much at key N.L 0.93 as at 0.49, and section 4 of rounds/reports/r7-fruit-mat.md solved it at 0.755-0.932 while BOTH shipped frames sit at N.L ~ 0.5 (bench r7 @0.487 = 131.1, shipped r7 = 131.0; bench r6 @0.487 = 120.7 / @0.755 = 138.3, shipped r6 = 125.7). Move the bundle's lift off the diffuse and onto the transmission floor — `sssMask` is already multiplied by (0.90 + 0.42*bun) at area mean 1.00, so raise that coupling and lower the diffuse-side `pale` by the amount that holds the N.L = 0.996 face where it is — and re-solve `capBudget` so its ceiling binds at N.L = 0.5 rather than 1.0. That buys the top quartile at the orientation the game actually renders instead of at the one the bench sweeps to. Take the G/R down at the same time: shipped flesh_GR is 0.4409 against plate-01's 0.3392, and section 5(i) already identifies the culprit as the flat achromatic env-specular lift on the ground and mid populations, not the bundle (whose G/R is within 0.01 of the plate) — so cut that term, do not add red on top of it. Do NOT buy any of this from stage.js's key or from the depth cue in gradeFn (stage.js:995): every round that moved an albedo and an exposure together has netted zero. ACCEPT ONLY ON SHIPPED FRAMES through the frozen suite, quoting win and mask_px with every number, and NOT on a bench prediction — the bench has now over-predicted the shipped delta by 6x, 4x and 3x in three consecutive rounds: (1) `foam shots/r8/05-cut+500ms.png` returns flesh_mean_rgb R >= 165 with flesh_GR <= 0.40 (r7: 131.0 / 0.4409; plate-01 189.2 / 0.3392), while speck_cov_pct stays <= 18.97 and pct_R_ge_255 <= 4.11 (r7's values — the face's small-scale statistics are nearly at the plate and must not be spent); (2) `collar shots/r8/05-cut+500ms.png` keeps ridge pct_R_ge_255 <= 42.78% and ridge_max_over_min >= 2.0, and the derived collar:flesh luma lands in 2.3..2.9 (plate-01 2.596) — the collar must not ride the face's new exposure back to the ceiling, and it must not be dimmed further to fake the ratio a second time; (3) `foam shots/r8-iphone/05-cut+500ms.png win=252:340:90:180` returns flesh_mean_rgb R >= 140 (r7 98.1) — if the portrait face cannot follow the landscape one, that is the LOD-vs-level bug I could not prove this round and it is worth finding then; (4) if and only if (1)-(3) hold, the next thing on this axis is the collar's SHAPE: ridge_width_px_med / sqrt(mask_px) down from 0.0448 toward plate-01's 0.0281 and ridge_width_cv up from 0.648 toward 0.925.
